title: Countdown
prompt: countdown(n) should return [n, n-1, ..., 1]. Right now it never finishes.
starter:
def countdown(n):
    # countdown(3) -> [3, 2, 1]
    # Tip: a while loop needs something inside it that moves toward the exit.
    result = []
    while n > 0:
        result.append(n)
    return result
hints: The tests time out, so the loop never stops. What would make 'n > 0' become False?
Nothing inside the loop changes n.
Decrease n by one each time round the loop: n -= 1.
explanation: The loop condition depended on n, but n was never changed inside the loop, so it ran forever.
